releases.notes: 11-bit CAN output for a dash, logger or ECU: switch on the CAN tab, sensor values only, 8 or 16 bits each, configurable output address, per-sensor Scale and Offset (blank = Auto). Normal 29-bit CAN and WiFi to can2gauge unchanged. Settings from 1.4 carry over.

First public release: 8 sensors to CAN and ESP-NOW (with CAN relay), shared settings and dial ranges with can2gauge, 12 MB logger with CSV, 10-minute trends, protected 5 V rails. 1.4.1: Title Case buttons, phone-friendly rails / logs tables.
